Name: Size
Description: Controls the overall scale of the craggy features. Higher values produce larger cracked rock formations on the surface.

Name: Depth
Description: Sets the depth or prominence of the cracks and rock features, determining how pronounced the craggy shapes appear.

Name: Shape
Description: Defines the overall form and pattern of the cracked rock shapes, affecting their outline and distribution.

Name: Seed
Description: Randomization seed for generating unique variations of the craggy rock patterns. Changing the seed produces different results.
